Regression likelihoods, treatment of errors and upper limits, and covariance for both fitted relations.
Consistent definition of IRX across the prose, tables and fitting equations.

referee_caveats_inferred: ALPINE is described as Band 7 in the data and stacking sections but as Band 6 in the FIR-luminosity section.
Stated ALPINE stacking intervals z = 4.0–4.5 and 4.8–5.4 conflict with tabulated mean redshifts near 4.52 and 5.57.
IRX is defined logarithmically in the introduction, while the IRX–β equation uses a ratio-like expression and the mass relation applies log10 to IRX; resolve conventions before implementation.
The supplied IRX–β equation has unmatched parentheses; do not silently repair its algebra.
Individual ALPINE β values in the appendix are attributed to Faisst20, despite the main methods describing new individual SED fits.
Reported detection fractions and stack significances vary across sections; use explicitly identified table measurements as numerical checks.
The common FIR SED is central to the no-evolution conclusion and is not independently measured for most galaxies.
No executable workflow, software versions or complete statistical fitting specification is supplied.
